1/ Cash Flow Brief, Nov 10 ☀️

The 8:30 AM CPI inflation report is the biggest thing for your wallet today.

What happened, why it matters, and what could happen next 🧵

2/ Politics: Trump told CNN an Iran strike is "highly unlikely" if talks progress and a strong deal is signed.

Why it matters: oil and Gulf shipping risk feed into fuel prices.

Next: if talks stall, oil risk could rise again.

3/ Economy: October CPI hits at 8:30 AM today. Forecast 0.3% m/m, core 0.2%.

Why it matters: a hot print can push rate hopes up, raising mortgage and card costs.

Next: if inflation runs hot, December hike talk grows. Watch yields and the dollar.

4/ Stocks: Friday, Nvidia fell 8.8% on the week and Oklo jumped 22.7%. Thursday's S&P 500 drop was 4.4%.

Why it matters: sharp swings like this can hit 401(k)s fast.

Next: if CoreWeave's report today disappoints, the chip rebound may fade.

5/ Crypto: Bitcoin is near $74K, Fear and Greed at 32. ETFs saw $1.177B net outflows last week.

Why it matters: weak ETF demand means less buying support.

Next: if CPI runs hot, pressure may persist.

Not financial advice.

Overseas, Trump says a strike on Iran is highly unlikely if talks progress, and Russia-Ukraine talks start today in Abu Dhabi. Oil and gas prices can react to both. Bitcoin is near 74K, and spot Bitcoin ETFs saw 1.177 billion dollars in outflows last week. Not financial advice. Follow for tomorrow's brief.

1/ Cash Flow Brief: Evening, Nov 10 🌙

Today's 8:30 AM CPI inflation report matters most for your wallet. WaPo said the pace slowed in October, while Bloomberg said prices kept rising.

What happened today and what to watch Wednesday 🧵

2/ Politics & world: Republicans elected Jim Jordan House minority leader. Russia and Ukraine began US-backed talks in Abu Dhabi.

Why it matters: energy supply risk can move fuel prices.

Tomorrow: Watch day 2 of Abu Dhabi talks for oil moves.

3/ Economy: CPI headlines conflict. WaPo says the pace slowed in October; Bloomberg says prices keep rising.

Why it matters: the 10-yr yield rose to 4.98%, which can push mortgage rates up.

Tomorrow: Watch if yields hold. Friday's PPI lands at 8:30 AM.

4/ Stocks: S&P 500 7,522.27 (-0.4%), Nasdaq 25,069.79 (-0.7%). Nvidia plunged 5.5% amid a CEO scandal, per Globe and Mail.

Why it matters: tech swings can move 401(k)s fast.

Tomorrow: AMC, monday.com and Sanmina report. Watch if Nvidia's coming earnings steady chips.

5/ Crypto: Bitcoin 73,537.21 (-2.2%), Ether 2,043.06 (-4.1%). Reports say the CFTC may charge Kalshi.

Why it matters: prediction-market rules can shape which products you can trade.

Tomorrow: Watch for any CFTC move on Kalshi.

Not financial advice.
